_comment: Paste these entries into the consumer repository's knowledge/capabilities.json (the STANDING ledger) after reviewing them. Standing rather than goal-scoped because visual verification is needed by every run in this repository, not one goal. Note what is deliberately absent: updateDebugScreenshotTest. See SKILL.md, 'Capabilities: grant validate, withhold update'.

entries.intent: Verify rendered UI against the recorded reference images, so that acceptance criteria about appearance, contrast and layout are provable by command output instead of being narrowed away or escalated
entries.command: gradlew validateDebugScreenshotTest (host-side, layoutlib on the JVM; no emulator or device)
entries.scope: this repository's screenshotTest source set and its recorded references

entries._withheld: updateDebugScreenshotTest is NOT granted, on purpose.
entries._why: It overwrites the reference images. An engine holding it, facing a failing screenshot test, has a one-command route to re-recording wrong output as correct — the same class of act as editing the approved Definition of Done. Moving a baseline is a human act, or a one-time goal-scoped grant made at an escalation once the human agrees the UI change is intentional.
entries.intent: (withheld — do not add this entry to a standing ledger)
entries.lifetime: goal, and only when a human has approved a deliberate baseline change

entries._comment: GOAL-SCOPED, not standing: paste into .harness/run/capabilities.json when a run first needs a reference image for a case that has none. It expires with the run, per the human's rule that a grant dies when the loop finishes the goal it was given.
entries._why_this_is_safe_to_grant_once_for_a_wh: The wrapper hashes every existing reference before invoking Gradle and restores any that changed, so only NEW files can survive it - the create/overwrite distinction the permission matcher cannot make, made by a script instead (ADR-002). Overwriting a currently-failing baseline still requires a human, exactly as before. What changes is that recording the NEXT new reference no longer stops the loop: the Calendar-Note alarms run asked for this same grant four times (D-003, D-004, D-006, D-007) and nothing new was decided after the first.
entries.intent: Record reference images for screenshot cases that have none yet, for the remainder of this run, without re-escalating once per case
entries.scope: creates missing reference PNGs only; any pre-existing image the run modifies is restored and the script exits 2
